shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Card hover/focus lift — appears only on interaction, never at rest.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on cards — accent-tinted ring plus the hover shadow.

shadows.name: drawer-separation
shadows.purpose: Separates the sliding detail drawer from the dimmed background.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: Detail drawer slide-in — exponential ease-out from an already-visible off-canvas position.

narrative.overview: VAAL inherits GitHub's dark theme coordinates almost verbatim, reading as a personal command ledger rather than a marketing surface. Density over whitespace, borders over shadows at rest, one accent color reserved for anything clickable.
keyCharacteristics: GitHub Dark palette shared with the audience's own daily tool — instant trust through familiarity.
Flat at rest; depth appears only as an interaction response.
Single saturated accent (signal blue), reused nowhere else.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is reserved for things you can currently press.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Shadows appear only in response to state (hover, focus, open).

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Runnable Rule
rules.body: Consolas is used only for copy-pasteable, runnable command strings.

dos: Do use Signal Blue only on interactive elements.
Do add shadows only as a state response, never at rest.
Do give every new interactive element a :focus-visible style.
donts: Don't use gradients or glow as decoration.
Don't extend chip colors beyond asset-type classification.
Don't replace the dark tone with a light theme — extensions build on this world, they don't replace it.
